  • There isn't much treasure here, but you will want the Steel H as it is the best helmet in the game and to get one of the five legendary swords the blacksmith made Nu Long which should go to Ma Chao.
  • While inside you should learn Ce Mian which is a special tactic, like Ji Mian this will neutralize enemy tactics, this replaces Ji Mian and is the final tactic in the game so you no longer have to worry about the chest bug.
  • On the outside head East to cross the bridge then follow the long path North reaching the next fortress. You will want Zhu Ge Liang to be part of the battle party with Zhou Yu as the tactician to use An Sha.

Po Yang Fortress

Gate #1 [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Ding_Feng Ding Feng] + Rebel Force x3 Have Zhu Ge Liang cast An Sha on Ding Feng while the rest take care of the Rebel Forces.

Switch back to have Zhu Ge Liang as the tactician. Boss Chen Pu ([https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Cheng_Pu Cheng Pu]), **[https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Zhang_Zhao Zhang Zhao]**, Bu Xi ([https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Bu_Zhi Bu Zhi]) Have everyone but Zhao Yun cast Bei Ji on themselves with Zhao Yun casting Ce Mian to block off their tactic use with someone casting Bei Ji on Zhao Yun. Regardless if Ce Mian stays up or not have Zhao Yun cast Huo Shen while the rest use Power Pills on Chen Pu first, then switch to Zhang Zhao and finally Bu Xi.

  • After the battle the center tent will offer you a spot to rest which you should use, after you do so leave and head North and East around the mountains going South to reach the next castle. Switch around your order so Zhu Ge Liang is part of the party with Zhou Yu as the tactician, also if you have spare Power Pills you will want Ma Chao to hold them.

Jin Du Castle

Gate #1 [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Huang_Gai Huang Gai] + Rebel Force x2 Have Zhu Ge Liang cast An Sha on Huang Gai while the rest attack the Rebel Forces.

Boss Sun Yu, [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Zhang_Hong Zhang Hong], [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Zhu_Zhi Zhu Zhi] + Rebel Force Have Zhao Yun cast An Sha on Zhu Zhi with Zhu Ge Liang casting it on Sun Yu, have Ma Chao use a Power Pill on Zhang Hong with the rest attacking the Rebel Force. When those are down have Zhao Yun and Zhu Ge Liang try to take down Zhang Hong with An Sha if Ji Mian was used.

  • After the battle rest up at the Inn, at the Merchant sell your remaining Battleax as well as two Scimitar's and everyone's Copper H since we'll be getting upgrades here. Make sure not to talk to the NPC in the middle of town yet.
  • At the Armory behind that NPC buy three Crossbow's to replace the Scimitar's and Battleax, then get Bronze H's for everyone except Zhao Yun to replace the Copper H's.
  • Use a Gullwing to Ji Zhou to restock on Power Pills then buy another two Gullwings before using another one to get back to Jin Du.
  • Back at Jin Du with Zhu Ge Liang in the active party speak to the NPC in the middle of town.

Boss [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Lu_Meng Lu Meng] + Rebel Force x3 Have Zhu Ge Liang cast An Sha on Lu Meng until is lands while the rest go after the Rebel Forces, if Ji Mian was used cast Huo Shen if it's still up on the Rebel Forces.

  • The first NPC above him will mention about a pack of Brigands they want you to take care of. You don't need to talk to the NPC really, but this let's you know to head to the South after exiting which you should do to find them. Also take Zhu Ge Liang out of the battle party and make him the tactician again.
  • You will eventually see a house which you should enter and make Zhu Ge Liang part of the active party before talking to the NPC.

Boss Pirate x5 Have everyone cast Huo Shen until you run out of TP or they die whichever comes first.

  • After the battle Gullwing to Ji Zhou to rest and sell a Scimitar while also buying 3 Gullwings then port back to Jin Du and talk to the NPC that wanted us to defeat the Brigands to get Qing Long which is another legendary sword that was crafted for us and is equally as strong as Nu Long, this one goes to Zhao Yun while you pass his Crossbow to whoever's Scimitar was sold.
  • For our next destination head South then East into the spiral mountains, when they all converge together head to the South then East hugging the Southern side of the mountains until you reach some gates. Bring Zhu Ge Liang into the party with Zhou Yu as the tactician.

Jian Ye Castle

Gate #1 [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Sun_Yi Sun Yi] + Rebel Force x4 Have Zhu Ge Liang cast An Sha on Sun Yi while the rest go after the Rebel Forces.

Gate #2 [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Zhou_Tai Zhou Tai], Xue Zong + Rebel Force x2 Have Zhao Yun use An Sha on Zhou Tai & Zhu Ge Liang use it on Xue Zong, the rest go after the Rebel Forces.

Boss #3 [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Sun_Huan Sun Huan], [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Xu_Sheng Xu Sheng], Lu Ji + Rebel Force x2 Have Zhao Yun cast An Sha on Sun Huan & Zhu Ge Liang use it on Lu Ji, the rest go after the Rebel Forces. With Xu Sheng alone have Zhao Yun & Zhu Ge Liang cast An Sha on him.

  • Gullwing back to Jin Du to rest up then make your way back here while having Zhu Ge Liang as the tactician.

Chapter Finale Tai Si Ci ([https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Taishi_Ci Taishi Ci]), Lu Sun ([https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Lu_Xun Lu Xun]) + Rebel Force x3 Have Zhao Yun cast Huo Shen while everyone casts Bei Ji on themselves, but have Gan Ning cast his on Zhao Yun. If Ji Mian was used and fell down have Zhao Yun & Ma Chao go after Tai Si Ci to bring him under 10,000 soldiers while the rest do the same for Lu Sun. Have everyone concentrate on Lu Sun, but wait for him to be under 6,000 before using Power Pills on him to prevent his Wan Fu use, then go after Tai Si Ci. Try not to use too much TP and keep your soldier count high because...

Part 2 Sun Quan + Rebel Force x4 You will not get a break to heal when you finish the previous battle, Sun Quan is one of three officers who have An Sha immunity so if you thought that would work against him it wasn't. Like previous part have Zhao Yun cast Huo Shen while everyone casts Bei Ji on themselves, but have Gan Ning cast his on Zhao Yun. When Ji Mian drops, if it was used, unleash your Power Pills against him.

Ch. 8 Assault on Wei

  • Inside rest up and buy 5 Elixir D's to put in Zhou Yu's inventory and buy another Gullwing for Zhu Ge Liang, also buy some resurrects to prepare for the area. While you're at is sell all the Chain M's & Bronze H's to upgrade them.
  • At the Armory buy Splint M & Iron H's for everyone except Zhao Yun as his helmet is better.
  • At the Historian invite Liu Bei so that this will be your new checkpoint and talk with him.
  • Before continuing to the next area you will want to get the generals Tai Si Ci & Lu Sun to replace Ma Chao & Huang Zhong respectively so Gullwing to Jin Du and walk around the hills until you get these two.
  • After getting these generals Gullwing to Ji Zhou to rest up then buy Power Pills if you used any and 3 Gullwings using one to port back to Jian Ye and rearrange your party and equipment to meet the following.
  • You will want characters whose INT is higher than 167 to lessen the risk for An Sha's landing, Tai Si Ci's STR & soldier count make up for his lower INT. Another thing to note is that during this chapter any generals you defeat at their post will not be available for recruiting until after the chapter is over.

The party I have is Tai Si Ci, Zhao Yun, ☆Zhu Ge Liang, Lu Sun, Gan Ning, Ma Dai, Zhou Yu.

  • At Jin Du head East and follow the path South hugging the Northern wall eventually finding a gate, you will want Zhu Ge Lian in the active party with Zhou Yu as the tactician.

Guang Ling

Gate Xia Hou Yuan ([https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Xiahou_Yuan Xiahou Yuan]) + Rebel Force x4 Have Zhu Ge Liang cast An Sha on Xia Hou Yuan while the rest go after the Rebel Forces.

Main Boss [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Zhang_Liao Zhang Liao] , [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Cao_Zhen Cao Zhen] + Rebel Force x3 Have Zhu Ge Liang cast An Sha on Cao Zhen and Lu Sun cast it on Zhang Liao with your physical attackers going after the Rebel Forces, Keep attempting An Sha's as long as you have TP to try to take down Zhang Liao before the physical attackers do it.

  • [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Jiang_Wei Jiang Wei] is the first NPC in town who if you tell him you have Zhu Ge Liang with you he'll join your forces.
  • There is a bush that is awkwardly not lined up like the rest on the East side which if you search under it you'll find Bo Ye another Legendary Sword this one I gave to Lu Sun.

image boye

  • At the Merchant sell a Crossbow and all of your Splint M's as the Armory has Plate M's for you to upgrade to which is the best body armor you'll get.
  • Gullwing to Ji Zhou and rest up and buy back your Gullwing as well as get Jiang Wei out of the billet to replace Ma Dai, after rearranging your party and gear record your adventure at the Historian and reload your save to be back at Jin Du then make your way back to Guang Ling.
  • Head West from Guang Ling past the bridge and prepare for a very very long trek zig zagging which ends with a gate in the way, you will want Zhu Ge Liang in the party with Zhou Yu as tactician.

He Fei Fortress

Gate [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Cao_Zhi Cao Zhi] + Rebel Force x4 Have Zhu Ge Liang attempt to An Sha Cao Zhi while the rest go after the Rebel Forces.

Boss Cao Pi, [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Cao_Ren Cao Ren], Xia Hou Dun [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Xiahou_Dun (Xiahou Dun)] + Rebel Force x2 Like Sun Quan, Cao Pi is immune to An Sha so that won't work on him, have your physical attacks go after Cao Pi with Lu Sun casting An Sha on Cao Ren & Zhu Ge Liang casting it on Xia Hou Dun.

  • Gullwing back to Ji Zhou to rest and restock on Power Pills, save at the Historian and reload your save to be back at Jian Ye and fill every free slot with Elixir D's. Then make your way back to He Fei.
  • When you are back at He Fei head West and cross two bridges before heading South where gates will be in your path. Have Zhou Yu as the tactician to take advantage of An Sha.

Ru Nan

Gate #1 [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Cao_Xiu Cao Xiu], [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Cao_Chun Cao Chun] + Rebel Force x3 Have Zhu Ge Liang cast An Sha on Cao Xiu and Lu Sun on Cao Chun while your physical attackers go for the Rebel Forces.

Gate #2 Xia Hou Shang ([https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Xiahou_Shang Xiahou Shang]), Xia Hou De ([https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Xiahou_De Xiahou De]) + Rebel Force x3 Have Zhu Ge Liang cast An Sha on Xia Hou Shang & Lu Sun on Xia Hou De while your physical attackers go after the Rebel Forces.

Chapter Finale Cao Pi, [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Cao_Zhang Cao Zhang], [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Cao_Ang Cao Ang], Xia Hou Mao ([https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Xiahou_Mao Xiahou Mao]) + Rebel Force Cao Pi like last time is immune to An Sha so don't try it on him, have Jiang Wei cast An Sha on Xia Hou Mao, Zhu Ge Liang on Cao Zhang & Lu Sun on Cao Ang. Focus your physical attacks on Cao Pi afterward.

After the battle Si Ma Yi ([https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Sima_Yi Sima Yi]) will arrive seemingly to help Cao Pi, but instead betray him and gives his head to you while taking control of Wei. An unblockable thunder magic will happen knocking your party out sending you back to Liu Bei.

Ch. 9 Unification

  • After Si Ma Yi's thunder magic you will wake up at Jian Ye, you will want to purchase 3 Gullwings while you're here and talk with Liu Bei, he'll mention to go to Chang Sha to figure how to counter Si Ma Yi's magic.
  • However Gullwing to Nan Yang and get 2 Steed's to do the final recruiting of our party now that Cao Pi is dead, save at the Historian and reload your save to start at Jian Ye and head into Wei territory to look for Zhang Liao & Xia Hou Dun.
  • Your final party if following the guide should be Zhao Yun, Jiang Wei, Zhang Liao, Xia Hou Dun, Lu Sun, ☆Zhu Ge Liang, Zhou Yu. Gullwing to Chang Sha and head to the palace and speak with [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Guan_Suo Guan Suo] to learn how to counter Si Ma Yi's thunder magic.
  • Then head to the billet to put Zhang Liao & Xia Hou Dun in your party and fill you party with Power Pills, and Gullwing back to Jian Ye to restock on Elixir D's and backtrack all the way back to Ru Nan having Zhu Ge Liang as the tactician this time.
  • When Si Ma Yi attempts to do his thunder magic again after his text finishes press @@*@@@@*@@@@$^@@*@@@ to negate his magic to properly battle him

Rematch Si Ma Yi, [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Xu_Zhu Xu Zhu], [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Dian_Wei Dian Wei] + Rebel Force x2 Like Cao Pi, Si Ma Yi has An Sha immunity so it won't work on him. Have everyone cast Bei Ji on themselves in the first round and have your high INT generals cast Huo Shen to chip them down then aim for Xu Zhu & Dian Wei to leave Si Ma Yi by himself. Don't use Power Pills until Si Ma Yi has around 20,000 troops left to try and take them all down at once.

  • Ru Nan is a Gullwing point, the Inn is the second building you can enter. The Merchant is the building after with a well next to it.
Item Effect Cost
Resurrect Revive dead generals. 100
Gullwing Transport to certain castles. 200
Elixir D Heal 4,500 soldiers. 500
  • Sell your Iron H's at the Merchant so we can update them.
  • The Armory is the next building West of the Merchant that also has a well nearby.
Item Stats Cost
Lance A.P 170 65,000
Plate M A.C 100 (Body) 30,000
Steel H A.C 100 (Head) 40,000
  • Buy Steel H's for the Iron H's sold which completes the best Armor & Headgear of the game. Also buy 2 Gullwings before setting out. To get to our next destination you should notice what looks like an open formation of rocks West of the Armory, that is the entrance to.

Ru Nan Underground

image map

  • If you want to make this trip easier you can abuse an exploit by using a Gullwing back to Xu Zhou and complete an encounter then Gullwing back to Ru Nan and the enemies will be the Chapter 1 enemies instead of the current chapter enemies.
  • Not many of the treasures are worth it outside of a specific one, that being Wan Sheng the fourth of the legendary swords. It is pretty weak at 190 along with Bo Ye, I'd recommend giving this to Xia Hou Dun.
  • After going through the underground head North and take the Bridge you see then head South to reach the next cave.

Ru Nan West Cave

image map

  • This is the last dungeon in the game while also housing the best equipment such as the Halberd. It has 255 A.P, and while it may seem like a slight upgrade from Qing Long & Nu Long (240), Halberd will deal double damage by comparison gives this to Zhao Yun and pass weapons down in STR order. Another legendary sword you will find is Qing Guang, it is equal in A.P to Qing Long & Nu Long so give this to Xia Hou Dun and pass his previous one to Zhu Ge Liang. None of the other treasures are really noteworthy so make your way to the other entrance.
  • Once outside on the Western side heard North and cross the bridge and head West until you see another bridge with some forts, heal with Elixir D's if you have any to spare and make Zhou Yu the tactician so Zhu Ge Liang can be in the party.

Chen Liu Fortress

Gate #1 [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Niu_Jin Niu Jin] + Rebel Force x4 Have Zhu Ge Liang cast An Sha on Niu Jin while the rest go after the Rebel Forces.

After the battle switch Zhu Ge Liang back to being the tactician and bring Xia Hou Dun back into the party.

Boss Si Ma Yi, [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Yang_Xiu Yang Xiu], [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Jiang_Gan Jiang Gan] + Rebel Force x2 Have everyone cast Bei Ji on themself in the first round, if you have the Power Pills to do so use them on Yang Xiu first to reduce the chances of Ji Mian being cast by him and Si Ma Yi. If you get stuck in a Ji Mian loop cast Jin Xian to recover soldiers, when Yang Xiu goes down focus you efforts on Jiang Gan then on Si Ma Yi, when Si Ma Yi is around 20K troops left you'll want to use Power Pills to make sure he doesn't Wan Fu back to full.

Continue East after the Fortress then cross the bridge you see then head West and North inbetween some mountains you should see Chin.

Chin Castle

Boss Xun Huo ([https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Xun_Yu Xun Yu]), [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Li_Dian Li Dian], [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Wang_Shuang Wang Shuang] + Rebel Force x2 If you have enough spare TP cast Bei Ji on enough of your highest STR characters that you still have around 16 cast as many as you can and focus on Xun Huo, after he is down take the others down in whatever order you want.

After the battle take a nice earned rest at the Inn which is the first building on the top when you enter. When you leave their is a newly formed bridge that leads to the forts of Luo Yang. However before going up you will want to restock on items so Gullwing to Ji Zhou to do so, after restocking on Power Pills and selling excess gear Gullwing to Xu Zhou and make your way back to Luo Yang the same way we did back in Ch.2 and go to the forts, if you try to go to Chang An in hopes of attacking Luo Yan from behind there is a barricade in the way so you have to attack from the front.

Rebuilt Luo Yang

These are the last battles of the game so feel free to go all out with your TP, you can rest at Chin to the South if you need to get your TP back. Have Zhu Ge Liang replace Xia Hou Dun and make Zhou Yu the tactician before starting.

Gate #1 Dian Wei, [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Hou_Cheng Hou Cheng], [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Liu_Ye Liu Ye] + Rebel Force x2 Have Jiang Wei cast An Sha on Dian Wei, Zhu Ge Liang use An Sha on Liu Ye & Lu Sun use An Sha on Hou Cheng and the physical fighters go after the Rebel Forces. Dian Wei is recruitable after the last battle he was a part of, if you have him he won't be here.

Gate #2 [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Liu_Dai Liu Dai], [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Chen_Qun Chen Qun], Lu Wen + Rebel Force x2 Have Jiang Wei cast An Sha on Liu Dai, Zhu Ge Liang use An Sha on Chen Qun & Lu Sun use An Sha on Lu Wen and the physical fighters go after the Rebel Forces.

Gate #3 Le Xin, [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Wang_Can Wang Can], [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Mao_Jie Mao Jie] + Rebel Force x2 Have Jiang Wei cast An Sha on Mao Jie, Zhu Ge Liang use an Sha on Wang Can & Lu Sun use An Sha on Le Xin and the physical fighters go after the Rebel Forces.

Afterward go back to Chin to restore your TP and make Zhu Ge Liang the tactician then make your way up to Luo Yang.

Penultimate Battle Si Ma Shi ([https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Sima_Shi Sima Shi]), Si Ma Zhao ([https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Sima_Zhao Sima Zhao])+ Rebel Force x3 Have everyone cast Bei Ji on themselves then focus your attacks on Si Ma Shi first then Zhao, they both will regularly interrupt to taunt you before their action.

Finale Si Ma Yi, [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Yu_Jin Yu Jin], [https:koei.fandom.com/wiki/Wei_Xu Wei Xu], [https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/Cheng_Yu Cheng Yu], Xu Zhu Have everyone cast Bei Ji on themselves, if Ji Mian is down aim for Cheng Yu first using Power Pills on him, when he's down whittle down Si Ma Yi next and aim to take him down using Power Pills. Afterward take the rest out in order of Xu Zhu, Yu Jin and Wei Xu.

After the battle head to the Historian and invite Liu Bei to Luo Yang and then talk to him in the palace and enjoy the ending.
